@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The police i______ted the scene of the murder carefully and interviewed several witnesses.
= inspected
~詞義 inspect（v.）檢視
~原文 The police inspected the scene of the murder carefully and interviewed several witnesses.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: On weekends, I like to go to the c______a to watch a movie.
= cinema
~詞義 cinema（n.）電影院
~原文 On weekends, I like to go to the cinema to watch a movie.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The basketball team beat every other team and won the c______p in the end.
= championship
~詞義 championship（n.）冠軍頭銜;冠軍地位
~原文 The basketball team beat every other team and won the championship in the end.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Thank you for the ______ (invite) to your party.
= invitation
~詞義 invitation（n.）邀請
~原文 Thank you for the invitation to your party.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: I forgot to put the soup in the refrigerator, and now it is ______ (rot).
= rotten
~詞義 rotten（adj.）腐壞的
~原文 I forgot to put the soup in the refrigerator, and now it is rotten.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Everyone cheered as the ______ walked on stage to receive a gold medal for his outstanding performance.
A: holder
B: inspector
C: champion
D: robber
= C
~詞義 champion（n.）冠軍
~原文 Everyone cheered as the champion walked on stage to receive a gold medal for his outstanding performance.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Nowadays, many essential goods and services can be purchased online with ______ payment.
A: romantic
B: mathematical
C: electronic
D: democratic
= C
~詞義 electronic（adj.）電子的
~原文 Nowadays, many essential goods and services can be purchased online with electronic payment.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Kathy is not allowed to use the kitchen anymore because she always makes a terrible ______ when she cooks.
A: mess
B: chill
C: haste
D: rust
= A
~詞義 mess（n.）混亂
~原文 Kathy is not allowed to use the kitchen anymore because she always makes a terrible mess when she cooks.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The lady lost her ______ on the MRT. Luckily, someone handed it in at the police station, and all her money was still inside.
A: chill
B: bull
C: purse
D: gang
= C
~詞義 purse（n.）皮包
~原文 The lady lost her purse on the MRT. Luckily, someone handed it in at the police station, and all her money was still inside.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The winter is fast approaching. It is ______ in the house at night, and the days are getting shorter.
A: hasty
B: messy
C: chilly
D: rusty
= C
~詞義 chilly（adj.）寒冷的
~原文 The winter is fast approaching. It is chilly in the house at night, and the days are getting shorter.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: robbed
B: hopeful
C: relieve
D: beam
E: mathematics
F: mosquitoes

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: ______ helps students develop logical thinking and problem-solving skills that are useful in many careers.
= E
~詞義 mathematics（n.）數學
~原文 Mathematics helps students develop logical thinking and problem-solving skills that are useful in many careers.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: There were several ______ in my room last night, and I didn't sleep well because they kept buzzing around my head.
= F
~詞義 mosquito（n.）蚊子
~原文 There were several mosquitoes in my room last night, and I didn't sleep well because they kept buzzing around my head.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Years of war in the country ______ many children of their chance to receive proper education.
= A
~詞義 rob（v.）奪走
~原文 Years of war in the country robbed many children of their chance to receive proper education.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: I got a headache, so I took some medicine to ______ the pain.
= C
~詞義 relieve（v.）緩解
~原文 I got a headache, so I took some medicine to relieve the pain.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The job interview went well, and Daniel was ______ that he would finally get the position he wanted.
= B
~詞義 hopeful（adj.）懷抱希望的
~原文 The job interview went well, and Daniel was hopeful that he would finally get the position he wanted.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: hasty
B: rust
C: suburban
D: democracy
E: oral
F: robbery

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Most people in Taiwan believe in the value of ______ and exercise their right to vote.
= D
~詞義 democracy（n.）民主制度
~原文 Most people in Taiwan believe in the value of democracy and exercise their right to vote.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The man was sentenced to five years in prison for ______ and assault.
= F
~詞義 robbery（n.）搶劫
~原文 The man was sentenced to five years in prison for robbery and assault.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The old bike has been left outdoors for so long that it is now covered in ______.
= B
~詞義 rust（n.）鐵鏽
~原文 The old bike has been left outdoors for so long that it is now covered in rust.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Life in ______ towns is often slower and more peaceful than that in busy city centers.
= C
~詞義 suburban（adj.）郊區的
~原文 Life in suburban towns is often slower and more peaceful than that in busy city centers.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: We have a(n) ______ exam tomorrow. We will have to answer all the questions in English.
= E
~詞義 oral（adj.）口說的
~原文 We have a(n) oral exam tomorrow. We will have to answer all the questions in English.
